Core BPF migration logic for builtin program and buffer account conversion.

# Purpose
This C file implements the logic for migrating a built-in program account into the core BPF upgradeable loader format used by the runtime. It reads and validates the source program account and its buffer account from `fd_funk`, builds new temporary account images for the target program and program-data accounts, and then writes those accounts back to the account database. The main entry point is [`fd_migrate_builtin_to_core_bpf`](<#fd_migrate_builtin_to_core_bpf>), which calls the internal migration flow with the configured built-in program ID.

The file also contains helper code for temporary account handling and account validation. Functions such as [`tmp_account_read`](<#tmp_account_read>), [`tmp_account_store`](<#tmp_account_store>), [`target_builtin_new_checked`](<#target_builtin_new_checked>), and [`source_buffer_new_checked`](<#source_buffer_new_checked>) enforce account ownership, existence, and layout rules before migration continues. The code computes the program-data address with [`get_program_data_address`](<#get_program_data_address>), creates the new loader state records, updates bank capitalization and rent-related lamport values, and invokes `fd_directly_invoke_loader_v3_deploy` to deploy the new program data.
